description: This source file contains helper functions for fetching and processing available models associated with a team or key in a user interface component. It includes functions for retrieving models from an API, generating display names for models, and expanding wildcard model patterns into specific model entries.

methods.name: fetchAvailableModelsForTeamOrKey
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches available models for a user based on their ID, role, and access token; filters and sorts models, handling provider and specific models.

methods.name: getModelDisplayName
methods.description: Converts a model identifier into a user-friendly display name, handling special cases like 'all-proxy-models' and wildcard models.

methods.name: unfurlWildcardModelsInList
methods.description: Expands wildcard model patterns (ending with '/*') in a list, replacing them with the specific models that match the provider prefix.
